g.text: CODEX VAULT / SYNTHETIC DEMO
> codex-vault --help
Recover, verify and safely compact local Codex conversations
Usage: codex-vault.exe [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
Commands:
menu Choose a conversation and an action in the terminal
scan Find native Codex JSONL sessions
analyze Analyze whether a session has a provably bounded reconstruction suffix
archive Create an exact zstd backup without changing the native transcript
compact Safely shorten a rollout after creating a verified recovery snapshot [alias: compact-safe]
doctor Verify transcript JSON, manifest hashes and backup recoverability
restore Restore an exact recovery state recorded by Codex Vault
index Build or refresh the local full-text index of conversations and verified archives
search Search indexed messages; whitespace-separated terms are combined with AND
read Read an exact indexed passage and verify a backing source against its saved hash
mcp Serve read-only history search over MCP stdio for Codex and other MCP clients
prune Remove leftover scratch files, and optionally backups the manifest does not reference
help Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
Options:
--json Print compact JSON, including in an interactive terminal
--human Print human-readable output, including when redirected
--jobs <JOBS> Worker threads for the read-only batch commands (`analyze`, `doctor`). `compact` is always serial [default: 8]
--progress Emit one JSON progress line per finished session on stderr. Defaults to on when stderr is a terminal
--no-progress Disable progress messages on stderr
-h, --help Print help
-V, --version Print version
Examples:
codex-vault menu
codex-vault compact SESSION --dry-run
codex-vault index --cwd .
codex-vault search "authentication tokens" --cwd .
codex-vault read PASSAGE_ID
Use COMMAND --help for details.
